name: Wavy leaf purple coneflower
desc: Wavy leaf purple coneflower (Echinacea simulata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinacea simulata, commonly called wavy leaf purple coneflower, glade coneflower, or prairie purple coneflower, is a species of perennial flowering plant in the family Asteraceae.
